messages.subject: Question about API rate limits
messages.body:
Hi Adam,

We keep hitting 429s around 14:00 CET when our nightly sync job runs during the day catch-up. Is the Pro plan limit 600 or 1000 requests/min? And is it enforced per API key or per organization?

Thanks,
Dana

messages.subject: Re: Question about API rate limits
messages.body:
Hi Dana,

Pro is 1000 requests/min, enforced per API key. The 429s at 14:00 suggest your sync bursts above that for a few minutes. Happy to look at the traffic on your key if you send me the key ID.

Best, Adam

messages.subject: Re: Question about API rate limits
messages.body:
Thanks Adam! Key ID is NWL-PROD-07.

Also — can burst limits be raised temporarily for our quarter-end backfill next week? And who should I talk to about pricing for a permanent raise?

Dana
